name: NoClick app
description: NoClick's app, built on its TypeScript SDK: it signs you in with a password of your own, keeps your NoClick key on its server and opens on your account.

NOCLICK_API_KEY.description: The NoClick secret key the app acts with, in your account. Create one in NoClick's developer console: https://noclick.com/dashboard/developers

APP_PASSWORD.description: The password you sign in to this app with: at least 12 characters, best random.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs the sign-in cookie. Made for you.
